stem: A cube of ice floats partly in water and partly in kerosene oil. The ratio of volume of ice immersed in water to that in kerosene oil (specific gravity of Kerosene oil = 0.8, specific gravity of ice = 0.9) ?
solution: $v_1\rho_w g + v_2\rho_o g = (v_1 + v_2)\rho_i g \Rightarrow v_1 + 0.8v_2 = 0.9v_1 + 0.9v_2 \Rightarrow v_1 : v_2 = 1 : 1$

stem: A source supplies heat to a system at the rate of 1000 W. If the system performs work at a rate of 200 W, the rate at which internal energy of the system increases is:
The electrostatic force $(\vec F_1)$ and magnetic force $(\vec F_2)$ acting on a charge q moving with velocity v can be written:
options: $\vec F_1 = q\vec v\cdot\vec E$, $\vec F_2 = q(\vec B\cdot\vec v)$
$\vec F_1 = q\vec B$, $\vec F_2 = q(\vec B\times\vec v)$
$\vec F_1 = q\vec E$, $\vec F_2 = q(\vec v\times\vec B)$
$\vec F_1 = q\vec E$, $\vec F_2 = q(\vec B\times\vec v)$
solution: $\vec F_1 = q\vec E$, $\vec F_2 = q(\vec v\times\vec B)$
